Initial release of openclaw-auto-skill-orchestrator, an advanced orchestrator for OpenClaw skills.

- Automatically selects, composes, executes, verifies, and recovers across OpenClaw skills based on user intent—no need to name skills explicitly.
- Introduces ClawHub professional standard for skill documentation and process, covering overview, usage, common mistakes, red flags, and references.
- Ensures dependency order, conflict resolution, and result verification for optimal task execution.
- Minimizes context bloat by auto-selecting only the most relevant skill set for each user task.
- Prioritizes skill safety: skill routing, loop protection, fallback selection, and auto-recovery are built in.
